title: Lightly Modded Vanilla
description: A simple modpack for playing vanilla Minecraft. Provides performance improvements, a few visual tweaks, and some preconfigured settings.
body:
Lightly Modded Vanilla is a simple modpack that refines the presentation of vanilla Minecraft. It seeks to improve both performance and the user experience through the smallest amount of modifications. The result is a game that presents itself in a new light while playing exactly like the original. --- ### Some of the changes: - Performance optimizations via [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core), and more - Thematic GUI tweaks via [Cursors Extended](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-cursor), [Slightly Improved Font (32x)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/slightly-improved-font) - Accessible typing features via [Emoji Type](https://modrinth.com/mod/emoji-type), [Scribble](https://modrinth.com/mod/scribble) - Smoother interface control via [Smooth Scrolling](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-scroll) - Contextual item information via [Peek](https://modrinth.com/mod/peek), [Held Item Info](https://modrinth.com/mod/held-item-info) - Better visibility via [Low On Fire](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/low-on-fire) - Subtle enhancements to the environment via [Simple Fog Control](https://modrinth.com/mod/simplefog), [Make Bubbles Pop](https://modrinth.com/mod/make_bubbles_pop) - Updated third-person visuals to match the first-person animations via [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations) - An improved resource-pack manager via [Packed Packs](https://modrinth.com/mod/packed-packs) - Shader compatability with [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) (_also, **sprint/crouch/chat** have been rebinded to `shift`/`ctrl`/`enter` (like every other game :)_ )
## F&Q
Where can I change the GUI size? **Located in:**\   _Pause/Main menu_ > `Options` > `Video Settings` The setting is labeled as `GUI Scale` and can be found under the **General** section.
Where can I apply a shader pack? **Located in:**\   _Pause/Main menu_ > `Options` > `Video Settings` From here, click on the button called "Shader Packs". This is located in the left side-panel.
